objective: Test M144 tuning repeatability and warm candidate ranking with identical inputs, randomized balanced interleaving and existing v1 file persistence.

flashinfer_source.implementation: Exact original diff applied cleanly to0.7.2, not full PR head; candidate source only for every arm.
flashinfer_source.native_loading: Reuse audited prepare_native(candidate): explicit JitSpec.build/load, identical module bootstrap in every arm; reject AOT substitution. One isolated candidate build workspace, fresh process/container per worker.

environment.hardware_change: Reuse prior H100NVL physical GPU if available; no comparisons to earlier HBM3 absolute timings. Hardware preflight must match this frozen expected model/UUID/driver before workers.

workload.api: flashinfer.bmm_fp8 backend=cublas through actual SGLang startup wrapper
workload.input_seed_scope: Identical model inputs and reset Torch RNG across every fresh worker. Trial ID and schedule seed are separate from data seed. Profiling synthetic-input generation remains the unmodified operation behavior.
workload.measurement_policy: unspecified; retain operation defaults and record actual profiler flags, tuner delay/repeat/warmup/global-timer state
workload.persistence: actual SGLang wrapper and existing v1 save/load; managed stores disabled
workload.m144_scope: Startup and serving both144; normalized cache key256. No independent tune256-to-serve144 transfer.
workload.profiling_input_limit: Serving operands are verified byte-identical by hash. Torch/CUDA RNG is reset to19, and the default synthesis is retained, but synthetic profiling tensors are not individually hashed. Dynamic profiling A is generated from uniform[-5,5] then cast; serving A came from Gaussian FP8 quantization. Do not claim identical profiling/serving data domains or bit-verified synthetic inputs.

protocol.trial_order: Ascending0..5; arm order v1/v2 on even trials and v2/v1 on odd trials; cold then warm for each arm.
protocol.candidate_pool: Fixed three candidates plus own natural winner if distinct, maximum4. Deduplicate by actual eight-word descriptor or default-1. Preserve source labels.
protocol.interleaving: Warm workers only. For3candidates use all6permutations repeated4times; for4use all24permutations once; shuffle complete block list with schedule seed. Position and pair-order balanced. Each candidate occurs once per block in both execution modes.
protocol.iterations: Calibrate each accepted candidate outside measurement, common iterations per execution=max candidate count; min20ms target, max65536. Normalize each raw block with actual common iteration count.
protocol.cache_switch: Materialize unique actual v1 control file per candidate with unrelated natural entries/policies preserved. Reload outside every timed batch, assert no memory promotion and true file hit; >=20ms candidate rewarm outside batch.
protocol.graphs: Capture once per candidate outside primary timings; check poisoned-output changed/restored-input replay. Each replay graph remains tied to its capture-selected candidate.
protocol.instrumentation: No native/choose/search/binding hooks inside timed windows. Dormant profiling-attempt guard remains; count all attempts before errors. Native acceptance and cache tracing occur outside windows.
protocol.startup_scope: Cold startup diagnostic; no complete-server startup measurement. Explicit native load/build and initial public API preparation excluded.
protocol.checkpoint: Validate first complete trial (4workers) before remaining20. Acceptance requires numerical/cache/source/timing validity, never a required speedup.
protocol.execution_mode_order: Per block: eager then graph on even blocks, graph then eager on odd blocks. Candidate permutation shuffles use order_seed for eager and order_seed+1 for graph.

acceptance: Pinned image, exact qualified descriptor overlay, clean frozen Git/source/native hashes and physical GPU/driver match.
All24fresh containers use identical quantized operand bytes matching original seed19 reference.
Cold actual profiles use retained flags/config and natural selected tactic equals a finite runtime-bucket minimum; v2 includes finite-1 and v1 excludes it.
All warm or post-startup profile attempts are zero; original natural cache bytes remain unchanged and cold/warm natural choices match.

Fixed pool plus own natural selection is retained. If any fixed descriptor or actual natural winner is rejected, preserve explicit reason/partial evidence and stop the batch as an error; do not accept a two-candidate replacement pool or silently remove a worker.
All candidate control files use actual v1 save/load, preserve unrelated entries/content generations, and are consumed from file-only state.
All measured explicit candidates accepted natively with used_descriptor1; eager and changed/restored graph numerical checks pass.
Interleaving, common iterations, >=20ms rewarm and raw positive wall/event sample normalization are recorded and independently checked.
Original natural tuner state/file bytes and serving winner restored after diagnostics.

analysis.independent_unit: Six fresh tuning/warm repetitions on one fixed input seed; no input-distribution or cross-device generalization.
analysis.within_worker: For each candidate/default contrast compute per-block paired latency ratios and a median of those ratios; retain all24blockvalues. Eager primary wall, graph primary event replay span including host submission gaps.
analysis.between_workers: Natural v2/v1 paired by trial; summarize6paired ratios with range, win counts and deterministic exploratory cluster bootstrap over trial pairs. Candidate results remain per-worker and per-arm; if using both arms for a shared candidate contrast, cluster by trial.
analysis.ranking: Report ranks/regret only within accepted preregistered shortlist plus own winner; never global optimum. Preserve pool and minimum-selection noise caveat.
analysis.objectives: Compare actual startup profiler margins/winner frequencies with independent eager/graph shortlist ranks. Different timer/execution conditions or synthesized inputs can explain disagreements; no causal GPU-kernel identity claim without separate observation.
analysis.scope_limits: No policy override, managed-store adoption, new SGLang production behavior, BF16, multi-GPU, model server, serving-throughput or universal v2 benefit.
analysis.natural_channels: Natural eager primary=wall, graph primary=GPU-event replay span including host gaps; retain both channels as secondary diagnostics.

publication.records: Preserve every attempt, exact raw bytes, numerical/cache/native build evidence, timing samples, neutral/regressive outcomes; one living Markdown for narrative/history.

resource_policy: One exclusive H100 allocation for at most1hour. Verify node/durable/downloaded full archive before release; retain binary privately, exact build/source/hash publicly. No CI triggered.
